text:
ava: Kicking off onboarding for oryx-embed-lite v0.3 on staging. Can someone run the standard recall/cluster sanity suite?

kai: on it. which quant config are we testing? int6 per-channel or int4 per-tensor?

ova: start with int6-perchannel (closest to prod target), then run int4-pertensor as a stress check. batch sizes: 8/32/128.

oliver: raised a quick job: `eval-run --model oryx-lite:0.3 --tests recall,umap,silhouette --quant int6 --batch 8`

zhen: FYI I saw a small drift on short queries last week with a different tiny model. keeping an eye.

kai: int6 run finished: Recall@10 = 0.741, Recall@1 = 0.642, silhouette = 0.27. baseline (onyx-embed v0.2 fp16) was R@10=0.752, sil=0.29. so small dip.

ava: OK small but within tolerance? what's the confidence over holdout shards?

kai: per-shard std for R@10 = 0.006. p-value ~0.12 (paired bootstrap). not significant.

oliver: attached UMAP preview: clusters compressed a bit in short-query region, but major topics preserved. link: https://stash/images/oryx-lite-int6-umap.png

zhen: running int4-pertensor now, will post numbers in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Job 432100 started by oliver: eval-run oryx-lite:0.3 (int4) --watch 

kai: quick note: batch=128 introduced a small tail latency bump in the microbench — might matter for low-latency routes.

zhen: int4 results in: Recall@10 = 0.693, Recall@1 = 0.581, silhouette = 0.21. that's a noticeable drop vs int6+fp16.

ava: ouch. do we know which queries dropped? 

kai: filtered by query length: short (<12 tokens) had the biggest delta. medium/long stable.

oliver: hypothesis: quantization noise interacts with recent projection-layer change in v0.3. I'll run ablation w/o projection tweak.

zhen: ran ablation (v0.3 w/ proj=v0.2) int4 -> R@10 = 0.712, sil=0.24. still below int6 but better.

ava: good signal. action items: 1) roll int6-perchannel as staging default, 2) hold off int4-pertensor for now, 3) oliver to open PR reverting proj tweak + profiling artifacts.

oliver: created PR #987 (revert/proj-ablation) and pushed eval logs: https://ci.redwood/987/logs

zhen: also recommend adding short-query-focused holdout set to onboarding pipeline (10% of eval). I can add it as a quick job.

ava: please do. also add an automated regression alert if R@10 drops > 0.03 on short queries.

deploy-bot: Note: job 432100 completed. artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/oryx-lite/4312345678/

kai: TL;DR: int6 ok to promote to staging, int4 needs more work (proj-layer interaction + short-query holdout).

ava: Thanks team. I'll update the rollout plan and notify product owners. :thumbsup:

oliver: putting a short checklist in the onboarding doc. small follow-up tomorrow to validate the holdout additions.

zhen: ping me when the short-query job is wired, I'll validate metrics aggregation.

ava: done for now. thanks all.
